prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts of what happened, if that's okay. I'm still sore and I'm not sure I can keep track of every detail.

Q: That's understandable. Can you tell me where you were driving and what you were doing when the collision occurred?

A: I was heading east on a main road, stopped at a light near a shopping center. Traffic was moving slowly, and I had come to a complete stop behind a silver sedan.

Q: Did you have any warning before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw the mirror fill with headlights for a split second and then there was a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you notice whether the other driver was using a phone or seemed distracted?

A: I didn't see him before it happened. When I got out to look at the bumpers, he was on his phone, but I can't say whether he was on it while driving.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes. My shoulder started aching within an hour, and by evening I could barely lift my arm above my chest. I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning and they referred me for imaging.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that shoulder or neck?

A: I had some stiffness a few years ago after lifting something heavy, but it resolved with a few weeks of rest. Nothing that stopped me from working.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble sleeping on that side, and I'd like to be kept updated on the claim.

Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
